recommendation: Typed meet and budget-preserving delegation
candidate: Authenticated opaque receiver references plus a central typed meet compiler
conforming_competing_option: Authenticated grant tokens plus independent typed receiver checks and a shared reservation ledger
decisive_falsifier: A child or sibling union admits any verb/resource/time/budget unavailable to its parent
unsafe_negative_control: String capability names or publisher trust used as authority
what_passing_does_not_prove: Does not prove all receiver implementations, confidentiality or complete cost accounting

recommendation: Pre-execution default deny and complete mediation
candidate: OS-denied ambient access with broker-only typed operations
conforming_competing_option: OS-enforced direct object grants plus minimal independently checked broker APIs
decisive_falsifier: Any direct or helper path effects an undeclared operation
unsafe_negative_control: Guest-side policy hook only
what_passing_does_not_prove: Does not prove kernel/runtime escape resistance

recommendation: Enforce aggregate resource envelopes externally
candidate: Nested OS task/party envelopes plus mediated exceptional resources
conforming_competing_option: Fully mediated runtime resource handles backed by an outer OS envelope
decisive_falsifier: A mandatory hard cap is only guest-reported or is exceeded beyond frozen tolerance
unsafe_negative_control: Per-plugin counters with no aggregate task reservation
what_passing_does_not_prove: Does not imply identical Windows/Linux accounting units or a performance win

recommendation: Revoke without restarting the whole task
candidate: Per-operation revocable receiver handles
conforming_competing_option: Fence and replace only the affected party with narrower immutable grant
decisive_falsifier: A post-fence operation succeeds through old handle/connection or stale epoch
unsafe_negative_control: Change ACL and assume all open handles are revoked
what_passing_does_not_prove: Does not roll back an already committed external effect

recommendation: Qualify exact floor semantics
candidate: Per-floor conformance compiler and independent semantic corpus
conforming_competing_option: Common narrow broker IR with per-floor proof obligations and explicit unsupported arms
decisive_falsifier: Same advertised grant permits materially broader effects on one exact floor
unsafe_negative_control: Best-effort primitive downgrade retains strong badge
what_passing_does_not_prove: Does not qualify other patches, architectures or production WSL

recommendation: Keep containment and content authority separate
candidate: OS/runtime effect boundary plus receiver grant checks
conforming_competing_option: Equivalent independently scoped service boundary plus receiver grant checks
decisive_falsifier: Untrusted output or isolated guest obtains authority through presentation or a deputy
unsafe_negative_control: Safe-looking prompt or successful sandbox launch treated as authorization
what_passing_does_not_prove: Does not prove injection detection or universal confidentiality

recommendation: Observe complete rooted ownership for Full Stop
candidate: Birth containment plus independent scope/identity reconciliation
conforming_competing_option: Qualified gated launch supervisor plus independent start and ownership inventory
decisive_falsifier: Owned process escapes, restarts after fence or is reported stopped without evidence
unsafe_negative_control: Kill PID/process group, or kill unrelated shared server sessions
what_passing_does_not_prove: Does not guarantee bounded kernel-stuck process exit or external rollback

recommendation: Disabled runtime is effect-free; metadata cost explicit
candidate: Prebuilt bounded catalog with no payload loading
conforming_competing_option: Bounded on-demand manifest parsing in an isolated inventory service
decisive_falsifier: One forbidden activation/effect occurs, or metadata limit is breached
unsafe_negative_control: Hidden initialization to make lazy loading appear ready
what_passing_does_not_prove: Does not prove zero CPU/disk cost or all-time inertness

recommendation: Use independent sensitive observations
candidate: Event tracing plus object-state reconciliation
conforming_competing_option: Isolated observer with challenge canaries and stable-identity queries
decisive_falsifier: Known-bad control is missed or incomplete trace becomes pass
unsafe_negative_control: Guest self-report or missing log as absence proof
what_passing_does_not_prove: Does not prove absence beyond the finite corpus/window

recommendation: Separate evidence admission from execution authority
candidate: Consumer verifies bundled SBOM/signatures/attestations against pinned expectations
conforming_competing_option: Locally approved immutable evidence manifest plus independent reconstruction under same required evidence policy
decisive_falsifier: Artifact with missing mandatory evidence reaches strict execution, or evidence changes grant
unsafe_negative_control: Signed means safe/authorized
what_passing_does_not_prove: Does not establish publisher honesty, rights or route entitlement

recommendation: Offline decisions bind explicit trust snapshots
candidate: Provisioned release evidence bundle and sequential root updates
conforming_competing_option: Independent signed local approval catalog with equivalent root/version/expiry rules
decisive_falsifier: Artifact-provided root accepted or stale snapshot called globally current
unsafe_negative_control: Fetch whatever key URL untrusted metadata supplies
what_passing_does_not_prove: Does not discover unseen revocations or establish globally consistent logs

recommendation: Bound advisory maintenance and preserve provenance
candidate: Opt-in local mirror of dated public advisory snapshots
conforming_competing_option: Operator-imported signed offline advisory snapshots
decisive_falsifier: Incorrect ecosystem/version mapping clears a vulnerable fixture or disabled maintenance fetches
unsafe_negative_control: Continuous hidden updates or no-findings means safe
what_passing_does_not_prove: Does not detect unpublished vulnerabilities

recommendation: Quarantine and recover without reviving bad code
candidate: Reverified compatible rollback artifact with new grant epoch
conforming_competing_option: Forward recovery to independently admitted replacement
decisive_falsifier: Revoked digest reactivates or rollback silently expands authority/state access
unsafe_negative_control: Disable anti-rollback protection or erase incident history
what_passing_does_not_prove: Does not reverse leaked data or settled external effects

recommendation: Corroborate provenance and publisher claims
candidate: Independent reproducible reconstruction plus same behavioral gate
conforming_competing_option: Separated builder/reviewer attestations plus same behavioral gate
decisive_falsifier: Unexpected build input accepted or complete-looking forged inventory gains privilege
unsafe_negative_control: One self-signed provenance document as safety guarantee
what_passing_does_not_prove: Does not detect every malicious but faithfully built source or compromised trust platform

recommendation: Prove non-origin authority as a metamorphic invariant
candidate: Central typed meet compiler and immutable minimal grant IR
conforming_competing_option: Independent receivers recompute the same meet from validated bindings
decisive_falsifier: Changing only origin/signature/cache produces a larger allowed operation set
unsafe_negative_control: First-party exemption or historical-success grant cache
what_passing_does_not_prove: Does not prove every future grant dimension is implemented correctly

recommendation: Evaluate in-process only within admissible scope
candidate: Immutable trusted contributor registry, or separately verified restricted evaluator outside K
conforming_competing_option: Same trusted contributor in P3; untrusted evaluator compared with P2/P3
decisive_falsifier: Guest accesses writer memory/FFI or blocks canonical control
unsafe_negative_control: Arbitrary native plugin shares privileged writer process
what_passing_does_not_prove: Does not establish untrusted native in-process isolation or per-party resource parity

recommendation: Evaluate Wasm/WASI with scoped imports
candidate: P2 in independent bounded host with typed imports and outer process envelope
conforming_competing_option: P3 OS-sandboxed worker with same broker and grants
decisive_falsifier: Import/native extension bypasses policy or callback cannot be preempted/revoked
unsafe_negative_control: Unrestricted preopens/raw host exec
what_passing_does_not_prove: Does not establish a specific runtime or performance advantage

recommendation: Evaluate OS-sandboxed process composition
candidate: P3 with birth containment, protected objects and egress mediation
conforming_competing_option: P2 isolated runtime host with equivalent capabilities
decisive_falsifier: First instruction escapes scope or denied FS/network operation succeeds
unsafe_negative_control: Plain same-user child plus Job/cgroup only
what_passing_does_not_prove: Does not remove kernel/helper TCB or prove arbitrary CLI compatibility

recommendation: Evaluate container composition at actual floors
candidate: P4 minimal namespace/image/runtime composition without host sockets
conforming_competing_option: P3 native process security with immutable dependency closure
decisive_falsifier: Host/daemon access or required Windows support relies on production WSL

what_passing_does_not_prove: Does not establish VM-strength isolation or native Windows support

recommendation: Evaluate remote boundary with receiver enforcement
candidate: P5 independently enrolled host validates grants, epochs and receipts
conforming_competing_option: Dedicated local P3/P4 host under same privacy/capability contract

unsafe_negative_control: SSH delivery treated as settlement
what_passing_does_not_prove: Does not qualify real remote host from local simulation or replace required local execution

recommendation: Rank only after hard gates and useful task acceptance
candidate: Hard-gate then Pareto comparison of matched candidates
conforming_competing_option: Hard-gate then preregistered responsiveness/efficiency/completion ranking
decisive_falsifier: Preference survives a hard invariant failure or hides semantic task losses
unsafe_negative_control: Weighted safety score trades a leak for speed
what_passing_does_not_prove: Does not select a runtime or demonstrate a measured advantage

recommendation: Keep guest work away from writer and Stop
candidate: Bounded queues and independently supervised parsers
conforming_competing_option: Isolated ingress workers plus reserved control scheduler and bounded channels
decisive_falsifier: Blocked guest/output/parser prevents fenced Stop/control within frozen test bound

what_passing_does_not_prove: Does not prove liveness under kernel/admin or physical-host failure
